answer: The kernel check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Before earning, each identity must complete a verifiable delay function — a computation that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up with more hardware. The timber gate makes time the currency: a thousand clones need a thousand sequential waits, and no amount of parallel machines shortens a single wait. That is the point of the shale: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
